name: mindfulness knowledge domain query with follow-up
description: Tests the offline knowledge shelf mindfulness domain. The user asks about mindfulness practice, then about present-moment awareness, then transitions to a personal anxiety topic. Verifies that knowledge responses are returned from the mindfulness domain, that reply length exceeds 40 characters, and that natural conversational routing resumes after the knowledge query.

turns.text: How can I stay present in the moment?
My anxiety has been really bad lately

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: 'mindfulness'/'meditation' keywords trigger both the knowledge rule (priority 55) and the conversational mindfulness rule (priority 40); the knowledge shelf answers the explicit 'tell me about' request, reply length > 40 chars. Turn 2: 'present moment' matches only the conversational mindfulness rule (the phrase is not in the knowledge rule), so the topic is 'mindfulness', not 'knowledge', and dialogueAct is 'question' due to the question mark. Turn 3: 'anxiety' keyword triggers the anxiety conversational rule, engine returns empathetic response from the anxiety pool.
expected.behavior: Turn 1 routes to the knowledge shelf because 'mindfulness' is an explicit knowledge keyword (the shelf's mindfulness domain returns curated entries). Turn 2 is conversational phrasing ('stay present in the moment'), which belongs to the dedicated mindfulness rule, not the shelf, so the topic is 'mindfulness'. Turn 3 returns to normal conversational routing via the anxiety rule.
